        "contents": "const HomePage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();\n  \n  // 从 URL 参数中读取标签页，如果没有则默认为 'featured'\n  const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\n  const initialTab: TabType = (tabFromUrl &amp;&amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl)) \n    ? tabFromUrl \n    : 'featured';\n  \n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&lt;TabType&gt;(initialTab);\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&gt;('recent');\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\n    if (tabFromUrl &amp;&amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl) &amp;&amp; tabFromUrl !== activeTab) {\n      setActiveTab(tabFromUrl);\n    }\n  }, [searchParams]);\n\n  // 加载数据\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadProjects();\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\n\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&gt;\n;\n;",

'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ?                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\\nimport { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';\\nimport { Project } from '../types/project';\\nimport { ProjectFormData } from '../types/project';\\nimport projectService from '../services/projectService';\\nimport FeaturedProjectList from '../components/project/FeaturedProjectList';\\nimport RecentProjectList from '../components/project/RecentProjectList';\\nimport NewProjectModal from '../components/project/NewProjectModal';\\nimport NewProjectCard from '../components/project/NewProjectCard';\\nimport ProjectCard from '../components/project/ProjectCard';\\nimport { Plus, List, Grid, ChevronDown, Search, User, Settings } from 'lucide-react';\\n\\ntype TabType = 'all' | 'my' | 'featured';\\n\\nconst HomePage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();\\n  \\n  // 从 URL 参数中读取标签页，如果没有则默认为 'featured'\\n  const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\\n  const initialTab: TabType = (tabFromUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl)) \\n    ? tabFromUrl \\n    : 'featured';\\n  \\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&amp;lt;TabType&amp;gt;(initialTab);\\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&amp;lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&amp;gt;('recent');\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n\\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\\n    if (tabFromUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; tabFromUrl !== activeTab) {\\n      setActiveTab(tabFromUrl);\\n    }\\n  }, [searchParams]);\\n\\n  // 加载数据\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadProjects();\\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\\n\\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 加载精选项目\\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; featuredResponse.data) {\\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载最近项目\\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; recentResponse.data) {\\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\\\"全部\\\"和\\\"我的项目\\\"标签，或强制加载时）\\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100,\\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\\n        });\\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; allResponse.data) {\\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\\n    if (response.success) {\\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\\\"我的项目\\\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\\n      setActiveTab('my');\\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\\n      await loadProjects(true);\\n    } else {\\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 更新最后打开时间\\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\\n    navigate(&amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;#96;);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    e.stopPropagation();\\n    // TODO: 实现项目菜单（编辑、删除等）\\n    console.log('Project menu clicked:', project);\\n  };\\n\\n  const getDisplayProjects = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    switch (activeTab) {\\n      case 'featured':\\n        return featuredProjects;\\n      case 'my':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      case 'all':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      default:\\n        return [];\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      {/* 顶部导航栏 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-40\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 左侧标签页 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('all');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'all' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'all'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                全部\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('my');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'my' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'my'\\n                    ?         "contents": "export const workflowAPI = {\nasync (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术包装\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\n\n    try {\n      let inputs: any;\n\n      if (searchResults &amp;&amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;&amp; searchResults.query) {\n        inputs = {\n          query: searchResults.query,\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\n        };\n      } else {\n        inputs = {\n          searchResults: searchResults,\n          template: template,\n        };\n      }\n\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-package\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech package API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术策略\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = {\n        inputs: { techPackage },\n      };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-strategy\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech strategy API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 推广策略\n  promotionStrategy:\n,\n};",

        },
        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const reportError = useCallback((message: string, detail?: unknown) =&gt; {\n    setGlobalError(message);\n    if (!detail) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(null);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (typeof detail === \"string\") {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (detail instanceof Error) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail.message);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(JSON.stringify(detail));\n    } catch {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(String(detail));\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const updateTriggerStatus = (message: string | null, duration = 0) =&gt; {\n    if (triggerStatusTimerRef.current) {\n      window.clearTimeout(triggerStatusTimerRef.current);\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n    }\n\n    setTriggeringStatus(message);\n\n    if (message &amp;&amp; duration &gt; 0) {\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        setTriggeringStatus(null);\n        triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n      }, duration);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 获取项目ID和是否创建新对话的标志\n  const projectId = searchParams.get('projectId');\n  const shouldCreateNewConversation = searchParams.get('newConversation') === 'true';\n  \n  // 根据项目ID调整 pageType，确保不同项目的对话相互独立\n  const effectivePageType = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    if (projectId) {\n      // 如果有项目ID，使用项目特定的 pageType，例如：tech-package-project-3\n      return &#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&#96;;\n    }\n    return config.pageType;\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 加载对话历史和输出内容\n  useEffect\n\n;",

        "contents": "### 2. 页面组件映射\n\n| 页面路由 | 页面组件 | 使用的节点组件 | 配置来源 |\n|---------|---------|--------------|---------|\n| &#96;/tech-package&#96; | TechPackagePage | BaseAISearchPage | techPackageConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | TechStrategyPage | BaseAISearchPage | techStrategyConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-article&#96; | TechArticlePage | BaseAISearchPage | techArticleConfig |\n| &#96;/press-release&#96; | PressReleasePage | BaseAISearchPage | pressReleaseConfig |\n| &#96;/ai-qa&#96; | AIQAPage | BaseAISearchPage | aiQaConfig |\n| &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/ai-qa&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | NodePage | TechPackageNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | NodePage | PromotionStrategyNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | NodePage | CoreDraftNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/speech&#96; | NodePage | PressReleasePage | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n\n### 3. 工作流编辑器节点\n\n工作流编辑器（&#96;/agent-workflow&#96;）中可用的节点类型：\n\n| 节点类型 | 是否有效 | 使用场景 |\n|---------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;agent&#96; | ✅ 是 | 调用AI角色执行任务 |\n| &#96;input&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输入 |\n| &#96;output&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输出 |\n| &#96;condition&#96; | ✅ 是 | 条件分支判断 |\n| &#96;assign&#96; | ✅ 是 | 变量赋值 |\n| &#96;merge&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据合并 |\n| &#96;transform&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据转换 |\n| &#96;memory&#96; | ✅ 是 | 文本存储 |\n\n## 三、节点配置依赖关系\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点配置流程\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. 创建AI角色\n   ├─ source: 'independent-page'\n   ├─ provider: 'dify' 或 'direct-agent'\n   └─ 名称/ID匹配节点类型\n\n2. 配置Dify连接（如果provider为dify）\n   ├─ connectionType: 'chatflow' 或 'workflow'\n   ├─ apiKey: Dify API密钥\n   └─ apiUrl: Dify服务器地址\n\n3. 配置Direct Agent（如果provider为direct-agent）\n   ├─ LLM配置（apiKey, apiBaseUrl, model）",

        "contents": "export const workflowAPI = {\nasync (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术包装\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\n\n    try {\n      let inputs: any;\n\n      if (searchResults &amp;&amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;&amp; searchResults.query) {\n        inputs = {\n          query: searchResults.query,\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\n        };\n      } else {\n        inputs = {\n          searchResults: searchResults,\n          template: template,\n        };\n      }\n\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-package\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech package API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术策略\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = {\n        inputs: { techPackage },\n      };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-strategy\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech strategy API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 推广策略\n  promotionStrategy:\n,\n};",

        "contents": "import DifyClient from '@/services/DifyClient';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nimport { ExecuteTechPackageDTO } from '../dto/executeTechPackage.dto';\nimport { formatAdditionalInformation } from '../../domain/workflowFormatter';\n\nexport class ExecuteTechPackageUseCase {\n  async execute(dto: ExecuteTechPackageDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;unknown&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const difyInputs = {\n        Additional_information: formatAdditionalInformation(dto.inputs),\n      };\n\n      const result = await DifyClient.techPackage(difyInputs);\n\n      try {\n        const userQuery = dto.inputs?.query || '技术包装请求';\n        await ChatMessageService.saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\n          result,\n          userQuery,\n          'tech-package',\n          dto.inputs,\n          dto.conversationId\n        );\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('保存技术包装消息失败', { error });\n      }\n\n      return success(result);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('技术包装执行失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'TECH_PACKAGE_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '技术包装失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowController {\n\n\n  executeAiSearch = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversationIdInput = req.body.conversationId ?? req.body.conversation_id;\n      const normalizedConversationId = typeof conversationIdInput === 'string' ? conversationIdInput : '';\n\n      const normalizedPayload: { query: unknown; inputs?: unknown; conversationId: string } = {\n        query: req.body.query,\n        inputs: req.body.inputs,\n        conversationId: normalizedConversationId,\n      };\n\n      const dto = validateDTO&lt;ExecuteAiSearchDTO&gt;(ExecuteAiSearchSchema, normalizedPayload);\n      const result = await this.executeAiSearchUseCase.execute(dto);\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          createErrorResponse(result.error.code, result.error.message, result.error.details)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(createSuccessResponse(result.value, 'AI搜索完成'));\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('AI 搜索接口执行失败', { error });\n      next(error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  executeTechPackage = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const payload = {\n        inputs: req.body.inputs ?? {},\n        conversationId: req.body.conversationId ?? req.body.conversation_id,\n      };\n      const dto = validateDTO(ExecuteTechPackageSchema, payload);\n      const result = await this.executeTechPackageUseCase.execute(dto);\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          createErrorResponse(result.error.code, result.error.message, result.error.details)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(createSuccessResponse(result.value, '技术包装完成'));\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('技术包装接口执行失败', { error });\n      next(error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  executeTechStrategy =\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowService {\n\n\n  // 技术包装执行\n  private static async executeTechPackage(inputData: any, context: WorkflowContext): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const { template = 'default' } = inputData;\n    \n    // 获取智能搜索的结果作为输入\n    const searchData = context.nodes.smart_search?.data;\n    \n    await new Promise(resolve =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 2000));\n    \n    return {\n      template,\n      sourceData: searchData,\n      packagedContent: {\n        technicalPoints: ['技术要点1', '技术要点2', '技术要点3'],\n        advantages: ['优势1', '优势2', '优势3'],\n        applications: ['应用场景1', '应用场景2'],\n        marketValue: '市场价值分析内容'\n      },\n      timestamp: new Date()\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 推广策略执行\n  private static async executePromotionStrategy(inputData: any, context: WorkflowContext): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import DifyClient from '@/services/DifyClient';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nimport { ExecuteTechStrategyDTO } from '../dto/executeTechStrategy.dto';\n\nexport class ExecuteTechStrategyUseCase {\n  async execute(dto: ExecuteTechStrategyDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;unknown&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const inputs = dto.inputs?.techPackage || JSON.stringify(dto.inputs);\n      const difyInputs = {\n        input1: inputs,\n        input2: inputs,\n        query: inputs,\n        techPackage: inputs,\n        template: dto.inputs?.template || 'default',\n      };\n\n      const result = await DifyClient.techStrategy(difyInputs);\n\n      try {\n        await ChatMessageService.saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\n          result,\n          '技术策略生成',\n          'tech-strategy',\n          dto.inputs,\n          dto.conversationId\n        );\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('保存技术策略消息失败', { error });\n      }\n\n      return success(result);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('技术策略执行失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'TECH_STRATEGY_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '技术策略失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 构建对话数据，包含根据contextWindowSize截取的上下文历史\n   * 此方法适用于所有工具（五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播、展具与视频、翻译等）\n   * @param conversation 对话对象\n   * @param conversationQuery 对话查询内容\n   * @param targetSources 目标来源\n   * @param dto 触发Agent的DTO，包含contextWindowSize参数\n   * @returns 包含历史上下文的对话数据\n   */\n  private buildConversationData(\n    conversation: any,\n    conversationQuery: string,\n    targetSources: any[],\n    dto: TriggerAgentDTO\n  ) {\n    const sortedMessages = [...(conversation.messages || [])];\n    // 根据contextWindowSize构建上下文（最近N条消息或全部历史）\n    // contextWindowSize: 5/10/20 表示最近N条消息，0 表示全部历史\n    const context = buildConversationContext(sortedMessages, {\n      historyLimit: dto.contextWindowSize,\n    });\n\n    // 获取最后一条助手消息和用户消息，用于字段映射\n    const lastAssistantMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'assistant');\n    const lastUserMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'user');\n\n    return {\n      query: conversationQuery,\n      sources: targetSources,\n      files: [],\n      history: context.history, // 根据contextWindowSize截取的历史消息\n      historyLimit: context.historyLimit,\n      historySize: context.historySize,\n      summary: context.summary,\n      keyPhrases: context.keyPhrases,\n      // 子Agent（如五看、三定等）每次调用都是独立的分析任务\n      // 不需要传递 conversationId，让 Dify 创建新的对话\n      conversationId: '',\n      featureType: dto.featureType,\n      lastAssistantMessage: lastAssistantMessage || undefined,\n      lastUserMessage: lastUserMessage || undefined,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPackagingController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 添加对话关联\n   */\n  async addConversation(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const { conversationId, notes } = req.body;\n      if (!conversationId) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '缺少 conversationId 参数'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const success = await techPackagingMaterialModel.addConversation(id, conversationId, notes);\n      if (success) {\n        res.json({\n          success: true,\n          message: '对话关联添加成功'\n        });\n      } else {\n        res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '对话关联添加失败，可能已存在'\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Add conversation error:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '添加对话关联失败',\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 移除对话关联\n   */\n  async removeConversation(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "class DifyClient {\n\n\n  // 技术包装应用 (使用工作流API)\n  // 将聊天响应转换为工作流响应格式\n  private convertChatToWorkflowResponse(chatResponse: DifyChatResponse): DifyWorkflowResponse {\n    // 验证必需字段\n    if (!chatResponse.id || !chatResponse.task_id) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Invalid chat response: missing required fields. Response: ${JSON.stringify(chatResponse, null, 2)}&#96;);\n    }\n    \n    return {\n      workflow_run_id: &#96;chat-${chatResponse.id}&#96;,\n      task_id: chatResponse.task_id,\n      conversation_id: chatResponse.conversation_id, // 传递 conversation_id 用于多轮对话\n      data: {\n        id: chatResponse.id,\n        workflow_id: 'tech-package-chat',\n        status: 'succeeded',\n        outputs: {\n          text: chatResponse.answer || '',\n          answer: chatResponse.answer || ''\n        },\n        error: null,\n        elapsed_time: chatResponse.metadata?.usage?.latency || 0,\n        total_tokens: chatResponse.metadata?.usage?.total_tokens || 0,\n        total_steps: 1,\n        created_at: chatResponse.created_at || Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),\n        finished_at: chatResponse.created_at || Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  async techPackage(inputs: any): Promise&lt;DifyWorkflowResponse&gt; {\n    try\n  }",

## 修改总结

已更新两个文件中的“Agent助手”按钮逻辑：

1. **`frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx`** - 第219行
2. **`frontend/src/components/HomeNavigationBar.tsx`** - 第98行

### 修改内容

将按钮的跳转 URL 从：
```javascript
window.location.href = 'http://localhost:3001/tech-package';
```

改为：
```javascript
window.location.href = 'http://localhost:3001/tech-package?newConversation=true';
```

### 功能说明

每次点击“Agent助手”按钮时：
- 跳转到 `http://localhost:3001/tech-package` 页面
- 自动添加 `newConversation=true` 参数
- `BaseAISearchPage` 组件会检测该参数并清除当前对话，开启新对话

修改已完成，可以测试。
